items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'old Dorsey' in the context of local musicians and bands in the area (Franklin Street/Luley Oster) but does not state they played with, met, or had a direct professional relationship with him, only that he was a known figure ('old man Dorsey') in the scene.

ctx.x: Yeah, Payton used to play over here. That's on Franklin Street, we called it Franklin Street. That was a different Payton. Yes, a different Payton. Different Payton.

Now, before you timed there, right along, it was old, the band was there in that section. That was old man. Dorsey? No, no, Dorsey was up further. They take Ruben Manuel and them was down in there. Ruben Manuel, you remember old man Ruben Manuel?
Yeah, that's why they had the brass band.
